hints: Set up the system: $2r + r\theta = 65$ (perimeter) and $\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = 225$ (area).
Eliminate $\theta$ by substituting $r\theta = 65 - 2r$ into the area equation to form a quadratic in $r$.
Solve $2r^2 - 65r + 450 = 0$ and choose the solution where $\theta$ is reflex ($\theta > \pi$).
walkthrough:
Set up equations for the perimeter and area of the sector:
$$2r + r\theta = 65 \implies r\theta = 65 - 2r$$
$$\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = 225 \implies \frac{1}{2}r(r\theta) = 225$$

Factorise and solve for $r$:
$$(2r - 45)(r - 10) = 0 \implies r = 22.5 \quad \text{or} \quad r = 10$$

Check which value gives a reflex angle $\theta > \pi$:
$$\text{If } r = 22.5: \theta = \frac{65 - 45}{22.5} = \frac{8}{9} \approx 0.889 < \pi \quad (\text{reject})$$
$$\text{If } r = 10: \theta = \frac{65 - 20}{10} = \frac{45}{10} = 4.5\text{ radians} > \pi \quad (\text{valid reflex angle})$$
$$r = 10, \quad \theta = 4.5$$

hints: The interior angle of $\triangle ACB$ is $2\pi - \theta = 2\pi - 4.5$.
Use the triangle area formula $\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}r^2\sin(2\pi - \theta)$ with $r = 10$.
Evaluate and round to 3 significant figures.
walkthrough:
Determine the non-reflex interior angle of $\triangle ACB$:
$$\angle ACB = 2\pi - 4.5 \approx 1.783185... \text{ radians}$$

Apply the sine area formula for triangle $ACB$ with $CA = CB = 10\text{ cm}$:
$$\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}(10^2)\sin(2\pi - 4.5) = 50\sin(1.783185...) \approx 50 \times 0.977530... \approx 48.9\text{ cm}^2$$
